methodology.financial_basis: IAS17. Lease obligations excluded from debt. IFRS16 net income is not substituted for IAS17.
methodology.operations: Published FY, H1, 9M and standalone quarters are distinct. Store counts are end-of-period snapshots. No simple mean of quarterly LFL.
methodology.valuation: LTM = four observed standalone quarters or equivalent FYprev + current YTD − previous YTD. Financial period end and verified publication date retained. Values appear only after publication day. Current revised databooks are used: this is not an original-vintage point-in-time backtest. No inferred reporting lag. Market cap in RUB million is historical MOEX, no multiplication by current shares. Missing historic GDR capitalization remains unavailable.
methodology.perimeters: X5 NV vs RU and Fix Price Group vs RU are separate legal/group series; no silent stitching.
methodology.novabev: Alcohol production/import and WineLab retail; WineLab operating KPIs are not group revenue growth.
methodology.cash_flow: CFO after rent less cash purchases PPE/intangibles, excluding M&A. Native IFRS16 profit is separate, not substituted into IAS17 P/E.
